meta.title: Odyssey Immanent Art Procedural Atlas
meta.purpose: Restructure a static scene atlas as an LLM-addressable, compiler-validatable oral-epic program library.
meta.coreInvariant: No generated surface becomes committed program text until entity, grammar/prosody policy, scene logic, continuity, provenance, and traditional activation are inspectable.

ontology.selectionModel: P(candidate) proportional to traditional association x prosodic compatibility x grammatical fit x scene relevance x audience recognizability; hard failures receive probability zero.

HALFWORLD.MONOCHROME_PAPER_V1.instancePolicy: Every actor, creature, prop, environment, vehicle, sound source, and effect remains independently addressable.
HALFWORLD.MONOCHROME_PAPER_V1.timelinePolicy: All beats execute in causal order on one master clock; distinct moments may not be flattened into one poster.

protocols.essentialIdea: Receive the stranger before fully knowing identity; host and guest acquire reciprocal obligations.
Return is an accumulating obligation, not mere geographic arrival.
Action is evaluated against the durable reputation it creates.
Indirect intelligence alters identity, information, and probability.
A vulnerable body invokes ritual protection through posture, touch, and speech.
Spoken commitment creates a future-binding social state.
Divine agents redistribute permission, obstruction, knowledge, and consequence.
Violence generates obligations of retaliation, purification, or settlement.
Control of food, doors, weapons, beds, servants, and inheritance constitutes rule.
Identity becomes valid through privileged evidence rather than assertion alone.
Material offering aligns mortal action with divine attention.
The unburied dead retain claims on the living.
A known prohibition converts appetite or fatigue into irreversible loss.
A sign compresses a future trajectory that listeners may accept or reject.
Parentage, marriage, and household relation define duties, proofs, and succession.
Narrative disclosure trades identity, hospitality, intelligence, and prestige.
Violence ends only when antagonists enter a binding civic relation.

referentialFields.description: Persistence through repeated loss, delay, and transformation.
Strategic intelligence, disguise, naming, deception, and adaptive planning.
The city-sacker whose intelligence also generates irreversible harm.
The return trajectory binding sea, home, family, memory, and identity.
The son moves from suspended childhood into speech, travel, judgment, and inheritance.
Delay, testing, weaving, grief, and governance under uncertainty.
Divine intelligence that prompts, disguises, tests, and redirects mortal action.
Persistent obstruction generated by violated kinship and wounded divine honor.
Hospitality performed in its expected order.
Hospitality inverted into predation, extraction, or violence.
A concealed relation becomes socially real through a sign known only to participants.
The pressure of future song and remembered name.
The relation among warning, mortal choice, excess, and consequence.
The contested house returns to an ordered but transformed social state.
The heroic world interpreted through death, burial, grief, and limits.
The past becomes operational through stories, scars, objects, songs, and names.
Identity divided between visible body, claimed name, and hidden relation.
Retaliation is converted into oath, settlement, and civic continuity.

Use warm off-white paper; hard black structural contour; eight-level ordered-dot halftone; blocky procedural geometry; crisp monochrome silhouette; no gradients, painterly texture, photorealism, cinematic blur, or baked-in unrelated figures.
